title: Kindness Because it is the Right Thing to Do
verse: If you see the donkey of someone who hates you fallen under its load, you must not ignore him, but be sure to help him with it.
observation: Today’s passage is a good example of how the character that God builds in us must be taken from His Word. It cannot be built by looking at the world or looking inside ourselves to find “another truth.” In today’s passage, it seems to command us to do exactly the opposite of what we may think is the right move. If we see someone we hate experiencing trouble, how many times do we think they are getting what they deserve? We may even say God is honoring us by judging them. However, the Lord tells us to help our enemy when they are in distress. Notice, it is not saying they stop being our enemy. We are doing the right thing because it is the right thing to do. By showing kindness, while not excusing their faults, we are creating space for possible forgiveness. Showing kindness may be the only way for them to see what the love of God looks like. They may say, “I know how much they dislike me. Only someone who has been touched by the love of God would ever do what they have done.”
application: How will you posture yourself to be ready to show kindness, within healthy boundaries, to someone today?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us first and giving us the capacity to love others.
